notes: Landmark boulder — tall enough to hide a kart, which makes it navigation furniture rather than decoration. More cuts than the smaller sizes because the form is close enough for a bare six-plane block to read as a crate, and a lower `embed` because a boulder sits ON the ground, it is not part of it.

rules.placement: Landmark boulder tall enough to hide a kart — sits on the ground as navigation furniture, not buried decoration.
rules.avoid: Avoid crowding mid-distance frames; one oversized slab reads as a wall.
